name: zendev-vitals
description: Live bio-adaptive load in the status bar, and a breathing guardrail before destructive commands.

commands.title: ZenDev: Run a command with the guardrail

zendev.guardFile.description: Path to the guard state file written by the ZenDev desktop app. Defaults to ~/.zendev/guard.json.

zendev.threshold.description: Load above which a destructive command needs one full breath first.

zendev.staleSeconds.description: How long a reading stays valid before the status bar shows ZenDev as idle.
